subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@acmefinancial.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial

Hi John / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo earlier today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and a proposed POC approach so we can align on success criteria and next steps.

Demo highlights (2–3 bullets):
- Showed Redwood’s inference runtime with a sample Acme doc ingestion and retrieval pipeline, demoing prompt templates and streaming responses.
- Walked through cost/latency tradeoffs, quantization profiles, and routing policies for mixed workloads.
- Discussed data isolation options (hosted vs dedicated) and audit logging for compliance.

Proposed POC objective:
- Validate Redwood can meet Acme’s latency SLO (95th perc < 200ms on 2k qps burst) and achieve embedding similarity precision >= 0.92 on the Acme evaluation set.

Success criteria (please confirm/adjust):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 200ms on representative traffic.
2) Accuracy: Embeddings + reranker achieve > 0.92 on the provided eval prompts.
3) Cost: Unit cost per 1k tokens below threshold we discussed (TBD in follow-up).
4) Ops: Traceability (request->response), KV-cache hit rates, and audit logs available during trial.

Proposed timeline (2–3 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff and access provisioning
- Week 1: Integration and data ingest (small sample set)
- Week 2: Evaluation and tuning (run eval suites, collect metrics)
- Final: Results review and next steps

Ownership / roles we suggest:
- Acme technical lead: Priya Rao (please confirm)
- Redwood AE: Camila Reyes (me)
- Redwood SE support: I’ll coordinate availability for the kickoff and integration sessions

Ask / next steps:
- Can you confirm the success criteria above and the primary technical owner?
- Any compliance evidence you need up front (SOC 2, HIPAA attestation)? We can attach our SOC 2 Summary if helpful.
- I’ve attached a short proposed POC plan and the demo recording for your team to review.

Attachments: Proposed-POC-Plan-AcmeFinancial.pdf, demo-recording-20260210.mp4

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up this week to finalize.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
cal: https://calendly.com/camila-redwood/30
From: John Smith <john.smith@acmefinancial.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial

Thanks Camila — really helpful recap and appreciated the demo. We’re definitely interested in running a short POC. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) On success criteria: the latency target looks fine but for accuracy we typically measure embeddings+reranker against our internal benchmark. I can share a small eval set. Is there a preferred format/size?
2) Security/compliance: our InfoSec will need SOC 2 Type II summary and network architecture for the trial environment. Do you provide a hosted sandbox or do we need to run anything in our VPC for this POC?
3) Data volume & sample traffic: for the initial run we’ll start with ~200k documents and peak query rates around 500 rps — is that within scope for the proposed timeline?
4) Cost & billing: do you have a trial credit or short-term pricing for this POC?

If we can get the SOC2 doc and confirm environment options, I’ll schedule the technical kickoff (Priya and I) — looking at Thurs/Fri this week.

Best,
John
Head of Search & Insights | Acme Financial
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@acmefinancial.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial

Hi John — thanks for the quick follow-up and great questions. Answers inline below and an updated POC plan attached.

1) Eval set format: CSV/JSONL with one record per doc and a small eval file of ~500 labeled queries works well. If you share JSONL, our SEs can onboard it directly.

2) Security/compliance: we can share the SOC 2 Type II summary (attached) and network diagrams. For the POC we typically offer a hosted sandbox in a dedicated tenant with data isolation (no cross-customer access). If Acme requires a VPC peering/private deployment for the trial, we can discuss a short-term dedicated environment — that will add ~3–5 business days to setup.

3) Data volume: 200k docs + peak 500 rps is feasible; we’ll size the sandbox accordingly. We recommend starting with a 10k subset to validate pipeline, then scale to full set during week 1.

4) Trial credit/pricing: we offer a standard trial credit for evaluation customers. I’ll pull the exact numbers and include in the kickoff doc; if you prefer a committed short-term dedicated pool we can draft a one-month reserved rate.

Updated proposed timeline (dates tentative):
- Feb 17: Technical kickoff + access provisioning
- Feb 17–24: Integration & data ingest (10k sample -> full 200k)
- Feb 24–Mar 5: Evaluation & tuning (run eval suite, iterate on prompts/quantization)
- Mar 8: Results review + recommendation meeting

Proposed success metrics (refined):
- 95th perc gen latency < 200ms on scaled test traffic
- Embedding+reranker precision >= 0.92 on your eval set
- Operational visibility: traces + audit logs for all test runs

Owners (please confirm):
- Acme technical lead: Priya Rao
- Redwood AE: Camila Reyes
- Redwood SE: I’ll bring in our SEs for the kickoff (will coordinate availability next week)

Attachments: Proposed-POC-Plan-AcmeFinancial.pdf (updated), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf
Related links: https://drive.google.com/proposed-poc-acme, HubSpot: 7890123

If those assumptions look good I’ll send a calendar invite for Feb 17 kickoff and include an agenda + pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks,
Camila

Hi John / Priya — Marissa here (Customer Success). Quick note to say we’ll support the integration and evaluation cadence Camila outlined. A couple operational notes: 

- I’ll coordinate SE availability for the Feb 17 kickoff and can prepare a lightweight integration checklist (data formats, api keys, sample eval queries).
- Regarding SOC2 and network architecture: I can share the SOC2 summary and a redacted network diagram ahead of the kickoff to help your InfoSec team.

- For the initial run, starting with a 10k subset and then scaling to 200k during the first week will minimize risk and let us baseline latency/costs quickly.

Camila — happy to join the kickoff and own the weekly evaluation check-ins. John/Priya — what time on Feb 17 works for you?
